brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
MOL Group has inaugurated a 37.4 MWp solar park and energy storage system in Hungary. [3]
Hungary is holding up Ukraine's EU bid over minority concerns. [4]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR HUNGARY
Hungary's hold on Ukraine's EU bid over minority concerns may be influenced by its 9 US OFAC and Canada SEMA sanctions designations, which could affect diplomatic leverage. [4][E2]

KEY RISKS
Hungary's 9 US OFAC and Canada SEMA sanctions designations pose a risk of restricted international financial and trade relations. [E2]
With a net energy import dependency of 49%, Hungary faces risk of energy supply disruptions if external sources are compromised. [E3]

OUTLOOK
A Kalshi market related to Hungary, "Where will Putin and Zelenskyy next meet?: Hungary", is priced Yes at 11% on Sep 28, 2026, and closes Dec 31, 2028. [E4]

WATCH ITEMS
The outcome of Hungary's hold on Ukraine's EU bid over minority concerns is pending. [4]
